reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a boxed question mark, universally understood as questions, FAQ, help, or quizzes. It fits tasks centered on preparing questions (for doctors, interviews, trivia) or editing FAQ/help pages, though it is less distinct than unboxed or circular question mark icons and should not be overused for any task that merely involves figuring something out.
